notes.title: Disabling Server dependency
notes.content: You can continue to play and receive cards every 3 hours, server dependency is disabled, you can no longer receive FCoins, view the gallery and buy new packs.

notes.title: The end
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!
I would like to start by congratulating you on the past holidays and wishing you all the best.

And now about the main news, unfortunately due to some financial difficulties, we had to stop the servers of the game. You will no longer be able to enter it, because the partial binding to the servers is preserved. We are very sad to say this, but this is the end of our small but very interesting story with Fap&Click game and like all stories will not be repeated.
Thanks to this game we learned a lot of new and interesting things, and most importantly gained valuable experience.

Thanks to all those who have been with us all this time, I hope to see you again

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.content:
[h1]What's new[/h1]

[h3]Interface[/h3]

We have completely redesigned the interface, you will now be greeted by a Christmas interface, we hope this will put you in more festive mood!

[h3]Music[/h3]

We have added Christmas music, which will also try to get you into the holiday mood.

[h3]Timer[/h3]

Now you can track your progress until the next card is drawn.

[h3]FCoins[/h3]

We continue to work on improving the FCoins drop system, so now every hour you can get 1 coin instead of 3 hours as it was before.

[h3]Christmas Pack[/h3]

We have added a new Christmas pack that has a time limit, i.e. once the time has passed, you will never be able to get cards from this pack again!

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

We have plans to implement several things, including what we mentioned earlier:
1. Rewards for daily login
2. Improvement of the FCoins drop system
3. Achievements

I would like to say a few words about the FCoins system, we have an idea to improve the gaming experience of regular players who do not use autoclicker. In addition to what we described before, we want to try to implement a system of “protection against autoclicker” based on pseudo random distribution. 

[b]How it will work:[/b]

The initial requirements for dropping FCoin will be 10% for every 1000 clicks, but if the game determines that you are using an auto-clicker, then the odds will decrease and the required number of clicks will increase. Once the game determines that you are clicking yourself, the odds will gradually increase to the original level, on subsequent restarts, the odds will be equal to the original value, we believe that this system will be fairer to regular players.

[h3]Design choices:[/h3]

We plan to make a store, for in-game currency, which will be FCoins in which you can buy skins for your girl, on which you click or backgrounds.

For those who want to make their own girl or backgrounds, read the following item

[h3]Workshop[/h3]

In the near future, we plan to connect a workshop where you can share your content, namely:
1. Cards, create cards and upload them to the workshop (how exactly you will make them is up to you), if we like your work, we will certainly add it to the game.
2. Girls to click on - draw, generate girls to click on and if we like your work, we will add it to the game and indicate its author
3. Backgrounds for the game - similar to the first two situations described above

[h1]And lastly[/h1]

We want to thank everyone for playing and wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year.
If you have any ideas and suggestions, write about it in the center of the community, we will look through all of them and if we like something we will certainly add to the game

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
[h1]About the changes[/h1]

[h3]Endless loading[/h3]

The essence of this problem was that initially we wanted to reduce the size of the downloaded game and get card images from a remote server, because of which we had a strong attachment to it. And when it could not cope with the incoming requests, there were errors that we could not catch. After reading the feedback, we decided to abandon this idea, which led to a change in the size of the game.

Now the dependence on the remote server is reduced by 70%, which allowed us to optimize the game load.

[h3]Drop FCoin[/h3]

In our game there is a system of FCoins falling out, we had several versions of how it can be realized, but all is that when using autoclicker all these systems can be abuzz, thereby breaking the economy on the site.

After a bit of thought, in particular thanks to the feedback of a user with the nickname [i][b]Drakzor [/b][/i](Thanks for giving us the idea) we have implemented the following changes:

1. Protection from autoclicker remains, FCoins continue to fall every 7000 clicks with a 5% chance of falling out
2. Now every 3 hours spent in the game together with a random card you also get 1 FCoin.

At the moment only a part of our new system is presented, in the next updates, which are already under development, we will finish it.

[h3]Error when canceling payment for a package[/h3]

Probably not everyone has encountered this problem, but its essence was that when you click on the pak you started an animation that was waiting for further action from you (Confirm or cancel payment), when canceling there was a chance that the animation will not close and will continue to hang until the restart of the game.

We managed to fix this bug and now the animation of opening the pack is launched only after confirmation of purchase, as well as we have optimized the display of cards after opening the pack (thanks to the refusal of the dependence of downloading images from a remote server). 

[h1]What we plan for the future[/h1]

[h3]FCoin drop system[/h3]

Like we said before, the FCoin drop system is not finalized yet, we plan to introduce daily rewards for visiting the game.

[b]How will it work?[/b]

Same as everywhere else, log in every day and get FCoin, every 7 days you will be able to open Coins Pack, on day 30 you will be able to open Premium Pack

[h3]New Year's update[/h3]

In the near future we will release a thematic update for the game dedicated to New Year and Christmas, this update will be purely cosmetic in nature and will try to bring a share of the atmosphere of these halcyon days.

Also, along with the cosmetic update, a seasonal Winter Pack will appear, which will be available for a limited amount of time and will contain new cards that you will not be able to receive later

[h3]Achievement[/h3]
It will probably take us a little longer to add a lot of achievements to the game, because we need to draw quite a few icons and think about the progress of getting them. We want the icons of our game to be not just pictures, but could decorate your profile.
